verdict.rationale: Every documented scoring and decision flow evaluates payment transactions: block, allow or review the transaction, risk profiles applied to payments, ML that scores transactions, and 3DS routing. Nothing in the evidence shows account takeover, fake account creation, or promo/policy abuse being scored or managed. The optional data-collection SDK on other site pages and Shopper DNA network linking only feed transaction risk, so they do not show non-checkout event protection.
